hooks.command: payload=$(cat); if root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && [ -r "$root/.claude/hooks/block-destructive.sh" ]; then if decision=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$root" bash "$root/.claude/hooks/block-destructive.sh"); then [ -z "$decision" ] || printf '%s\n' "$decision"; else echo 'agent-ops: block-destructive.sh failed; allowing call.' >&2; fi; else echo 'agent-ops: block-destructive.sh not found under the git root; allowing call.' >&2; fi; exit 0
